$comment: Trinidadian Creole urgent messages. DRAFT translation derived from en.json; needs native-speaker review and clinical adviser approval. Phone numbers and hrefs are byte-identical to en.json.

emergency.title: Dis could be a emergency
body: Wha yuh describe could be serious.
Doh wait to see if it go get better.
Dis app cyah check symptoms or give medical advice.
emergency.banner: Yuh tell we something dat could be a emergency. If yuh ent do it yet, call 999 right now.

urgent.title: Please, get help soon
body: Wha yuh describe might need a doctor or nurse to look at it soon.
Contact NHS 111 now, on de phone or online, or call yuh GP surgery if it open.
If it get worse, or yuh feel is a emergency, call 999.
Dis app cyah check symptoms or give medical advice.
urgent.banner: Yuh tell we something dat might need help soon. If yuh ent do it yet, contact NHS 111 or yuh GP surgery.

crisis.title: Yuh doh have to face dis by yuhself
body: It sound like yuh going through something real hard right now.
Yuh could talk to Samaritans for free, any time, day or night. Call 116 123.
If yuh in danger right now, or yuh might act on dem thoughts, call 999 right now.
Yuh could call NHS 111 too for urgent mental health help.
crisis.banner: Yuh tell we yuh might be going through something real hard. Samaritans there any time on 116 123. If yuh in danger right now, call 999.
